verdict.rationale: Meilisearch's docs explicitly describe hybrid search as combining full-text keyword matching and semantic vector search 'in a single query', with automatic embedding generation so developers don't manage vectors manually. This is a first-party documented, dedicated feature (hybrid_search/overview.md) rather than an inferred capability. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on community verification specifically of hybrid search quality or fusion behavior (community evidence covers other features but not hybrid search directly).
